No logo, no text, no printing, no branding of any kind. The ball floats in mid-air with no support, right of centre: its centre two thirds of the way across the frame and vertically centred, its diameter a little under half the frame height, the left half of the frame empty. Seamless pure black background (#000000) with no floor, no horizon and no gradient banding. Low-key lighting: a large soft key light from the upper left, a thin cool rim light from behind on the right tracing the edge of the ball, deep natural shadow on its lower right side. Medium-format camera, 100 mm lens, f/8, the whole ball sharp.

kling-take.prompt: One continuous locked-off shot in the style of a premium product launch film, every movement precise, weighty and perfectly smooth. @first_frame: an exploded view of a football — the charcoal rubber bladder at the centre, the cream lining layers and the stitched outer panels pulled apart along radial lines, the outer panels beyond the frame. The parts glide inward along straight lines and decelerate: the lining settles onto the bladder and the panels close in around it, @keyframe_1. The panels lock together edge to edge, seam by seam, into @keyframe_2, a complete football that turns slowly. The turning football then smoothly stretches and its panels flow and re-stitch into @keyframe_3, a white rugby ball with a lime-green band. The rugby ball keeps turning, smoothly rounds off and its panels flow into @last_frame, a professional handball with white, black and lime-green panels. No cuts, no flashes, no morphing artefacts. Locked-off camera, no cuts, no camera shake. Seamless pure black background throughout. Photorealistic leather, stitching and light; the same soft key light from the upper left and cool rim light on the right. No text, no logos, no people, no hands.
